Musi Project Reservoir Nears Full Capacity, Flood Alert Issued

An alert has been issued for the Musi Project reservoir as its water level is nearing full capacity. The Musi catchment areas in Nalgonda and Suryapet districts have been specifically mentioned in the flood alert.
